text:
Hey guys! UIC is hosting New Student Orientation at the University of Illinois at Chicago on October 15th at 3:00 PM in order to welcome everyone to campus. CLICK HERE to RSVP. See the attached flyer for details.

The University utilizes numerous resources to facilitate the matriculation process, and it is recommended that participants obtain sufficient documentation prior to the aforementioned program. Send an e-mail to the OSA with questions.
